data.title: 新垣绫濑 · 玄关走廊的鼓腮吃醋查岗
data.description: 公寓玄关木地板上，刚进门的绫濑拿着你的手机，鼓起腮帮气呼呼地盯着你。明明在吃醋查岗，却因为满脸绯红与娇嗔的眼神，显得可爱到让人恨不得立刻把她抱紧。
data.location: apartment entryway genkan with wood flooring
data.action: standing in entryway hallway holding partner smartphone, puffing cheeks in adorable jealousy while demanding a thorough explanation, eyes flashing with possessive love
data.mood: adorable possessive jealousy, cute yandere undertone, deep exclusive devotion
data.promptProse: Holding partner smartphone in the entryway, Ayase Aragaki puffs her cheeks in adorable jealousy, blushing furiously with possessive violet eyes.
